cohort: 100 mothers (50 obese, 50 normal weight) were included from C.S.I. Rainy Multispecialty Hospital, Chennai.
finding: Maternal obesity was associated with significant maternal and perinatal risks, including higher rates of infertility, gestational diabetes, hypertension, increased maternal and neonatal birth weight, and more NICU admissions.
mod_finding: Obese women experienced higher rates of labour induction and primary caesarean delivery compared to normal weight women.
